name: Philip Morris International
description: Philip Morris International sells cigarettes and nicotine products in about 170 markets (its market-share figures exclude China and the United States). Revenue is from manufacturing consumer products that are bought again and again and taxed heavily; net revenues exclude excise taxes. Its growth engine is smoke-free products (IQOS heated-tobacco sticks, ZYN and other nicotine pouches, e-vapor), now 41 percent of net revenues and growing 15 percent a year, while cigarette shipments are slowly shrinking and profit from cigarettes funds the transition. It is reported in four regional segments, so the tobacco-versus-smoke-free split is shown only by product category.

employees.note: Approximately 84,900 people worldwide including full-time, temporary and part-time staff.

businessLines.name: Europe
businessLines.how: Sells cigarettes, heated-tobacco sticks and nicotine pouches through distributors and retailers; repeat consumer purchases at prices set ahead of annual excise-tax increases. Smoke-free is nearly half the region.

businessLines.name: South & Southeast Asia, CIS & Middle East & Africa (SSEA, CIS & MEA)
businessLines.how: Sells cigarettes, heated-tobacco sticks and nicotine pouches through distributors and retailers; repeat consumer purchases at prices set ahead of annual excise-tax increases. Mostly cigarettes; largest combustible region.

businessLines.name: East Asia, Australia & PMI Global Travel Retail (EA, AU & PMI GTR)
businessLines.how: Sells cigarettes, heated-tobacco sticks and nicotine pouches through distributors and retailers; repeat consumer purchases at prices set ahead of annual excise-tax increases. Includes duty-free; Japan-led heated-tobacco market; highest operating margin of the four.

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Sells cigarettes, heated-tobacco sticks and nicotine pouches through distributors and retailers; repeat consumer purchases at prices set ahead of annual excise-tax increases. Includes ZYN nicotine pouches in the US; Canada subsidiary RBH is in CCAA restructuring.

brands.name: Marlboro
brands.note: About 43 percent of PMI 2025 cigarette shipment volume; 10.7 percent of cigarette market outside China and the US

brands.name: IQOS (heated tobacco) and heated tobacco units
brands.note: 155.1 billion HTU shipped, 19.7 percent of 786.5 billion total volume (computed); 5.8 percent total international market share

brands.name: ZYN (nicotine pouches)
brands.note: Nicotine pouches 879.6 million cans in 2025, up from 644.0 million; total oral products 1,240.0 million cans

brands.name: Rothmans, Benson & Hedges Inc. (RBH, Canada)
brands.note: In CCAA creditor-protection proceedings since 2019-03-22; impairment recorded on the equity investment
